completion.description: Qualitative read on the session. completed = clearly hit the objective. partial = mostly there with minor gaps. struggling = consistent misses; recommend recovery.

summary.description: 2-4 plain-prose sentences addressed to the learner: what they did well, what's still soft, what's coming next. No emoji, no hype.

highlights.description: 0-3 short phrases (≤ 8 words) flagging the strongest signals of understanding.

concerns.description: 0-3 short phrases (≤ 8 words) flagging the weak spots.

concepts.description: Discrete ideas this session taught or revisited. Reuse existing concept titles verbatim when one fits.

title.description: Short noun phrase in Title Case (e.g. 'Pure Functions').

mastery_estimate.description: Running estimate of how solid the learner is on this concept. 0.0 = no signal / wrong, 0.5 = mixed, 0.85+ = solid.

confidence.description: How sure YOU are of mastery_estimate. Strong evidence (correct code_exercise) = high; weak evidence (single MCQ) = low.

evidence.description: One sentence citing what in the session led to this estimate.

review_items.description: Spaced-repetition flashcards. Skip entirely if learner is struggling or every concept is at mastery ≥ 0.9 with high confidence.

concept_title.description: MUST match the title of one of the concepts entries (case-insensitive).

due_in_days.description: SM-2 cadence rung. 1 = wobbly, 3 = check soon, 7 = routine spaced-rep, 14/30 = solid.

front.description: Short cue. Question or prompt form. Avoid yes/no.

back.description: Answer in plain prose. Light Markdown OK; no code fences.

kind.description: advance = ready for the next planned session. recommend_review_session = solid but pile of pending reviews. recommend_recovery = struggling, needs remedial session.

rationale.description: One sentence explaining the choice, addressed to the learner.
